run_download_expert_scores: run the script to download expert scores from the jat-dataset for all environments and save to scores_dict.json
run_download_expert_scores_for_env: run the script to download expert scores for a specific environment like metaworld-assembly from the jat-dataset
summarize_ENV_NAMES: summarize the list of 130+ environment names covering Atari, BabyAI, Meta-World, and MuJoCo environments
review_scores_dict_output: review the scores_dict.json output file containing mean and std expert scores per environment
refactor_download_expert_scores: refactor the script to accept an environment name argument instead of iterating over all environments
